name: NIST SP 800-77 Rev. 1 (IPsec VPN guidance)
reference: NIST Special Publication 800-77 Revision 1, Guide to IPsec VPNs (June 2020)
description: Checks derived from the IKEv2 and ESP algorithm recommendations of NIST SP 800-77 Rev. 1.

controls.title: IKEv2 in use
controls.requirement: New deployments should use IKEv2; IKEv1 is legacy.
controls.reference: SP 800-77r1: IKEv2 is recommended over IKEv1

controls.title: AES encryption for the IKE SA
controls.requirement: IKE SA encryption uses AES (GCM or CBC); 3DES and DES are not acceptable.
controls.remediation: Configure AES-GCM (preferred) or AES-CBC for IKE.

controls.title: SHA-2 or AEAD integrity
controls.requirement: Integrity protection uses AEAD or HMAC-SHA-2; SHA-1 and MD5 are legacy.
controls.remediation: Use AES-GCM, or HMAC-SHA-256 or stronger.

controls.title: SHA-2 based PRF
controls.requirement: The IKEv2 PRF is HMAC-SHA-2 based.

controls.title: Strong Diffie-Hellman group
controls.requirement: Key exchange uses MODP >= 2048 bits or an ECP / Curve25519/448 group; groups 1, 2, 5, 22 are not acceptable.
controls.remediation: Use DH group 19/20 (ECP) or at least group 14.

controls.title: Perfect Forward Secrecy
controls.requirement: Child SAs use PFS (a fresh key exchange on rekey).
controls.remediation: Enable PFS by adding a DH group to the ESP proposal.

controls.title: Bounded IKE SA lifetime
controls.requirement: IKE SA lifetime (or observed IKE rekey interval) no longer than 24 hours.
controls.remediation: Set the IKE SA lifetime to 24 hours or less.

controls.title: Bounded child SA lifetime
controls.requirement: Child (ESP) SAs are rekeyed at least every 8 hours.
controls.remediation: Set the child SA lifetime to 8 hours or less.

controls.title: Payload confidentiality
controls.requirement: ESP encrypts the payload (no ESP-NULL or AH-only protection).
controls.reference: SP 800-77r1: ESP with encryption for confidentiality

controls.title: Approved ESP cipher family
controls.requirement: The ESP cipher is AEAD or AES-CBC with HMAC; not NULL or a 64-bit block cipher.

controls.title: No IKEv1 Aggressive Mode
controls.requirement: IKEv1 Aggressive Mode is not used.
controls.remediation: Disable Aggressive Mode or migrate to IKEv2.

controls.title: Signature-based authentication
controls.requirement: Peers authenticate with certificates/signatures rather than pre-shared keys where feasible.
